items.title: SC lawyer seeks suo motu contempt over Congress Kerala's deleted X post targeting CJI
items.summary: Advocate Vineet Jindal wrote to CJI Surya Kant seeking consideration of suo motu criminal contempt proceedings over a now-deleted Congress Kerala X post — "Dear Surya Kant, If law and order is not your domain, resign now. We will find your replacement who can handle it" — and examination of the reported demonstration/slogan-shouting inside SC premises during the INDIA bloc petition filing (Diary No. 64196/2026), seeking preservation of CCTV footage, access-control logs and security deployment records. KPCC president Sunny Joseph removed the staffer responsible, saying the post was made without KPCC leadership's knowledge; Union Minister Kiren Rijiju slammed the Congress over it. When senior advocate Gaurav Bhatia mentioned the matter Tuesday, the CJI said "Just mention tomorrow" — no proceedings initiated as of Oct 13. SCBA and SCAORA condemned calls for the CJI's resignation.
